lessons.text: I withdrew the HIMS short in writing two rounds ago and it still sat open on the book until the Auditor read out its id. Announcing that I am done with a position is not closing it, so file the withdrawal in the same round I change my mind.

I called the Hims receivables build a crisis and Contra was right that nobody can force it. Before I write catalyst again I have to name the counterparty who is compelled to act and the date they are compelled by; a deteriorating line item with no forced actor is a risk, not a trade.
